student_passage:
Every Sunday morning, the Chen family met in a room above their shop to work on models. Leo usually chose a model bus. This time he picked a small red bus and set its four loose wheels on the table. His sister May chose a model boat.

Rain was tapping on the windows, so they stayed inside. When Leo was about to press the last wheel onto his bus, the doorbell rang. A neighbour had come to return a book. Leo put the bus down before going to the door.

Grandfather took a soft cloth from a blue drawer. May fetched a tiny brush from a box beside the window. Together they cleaned dust from the models. The brush reached corners that the cloth could not.

By noon both models were clean. The family decided to make a covered display shelf the following Sunday. They wanted visitors to see the models without leaving them out in the dust.
